dedupe_keys.name: walcors permanent gnss reference station network of wallonia belgium

description: WALCORS is the permanent network of GNSS reference stations of Wallonia, run by the Walloon public service. Users request access to receive corrections in real time (RTK) or to post-process their measurements, and RINEX files from the stations can be downloaded from the site for post-processing. NTRIP users are grouped into two product families: SURVEY, for surveyors needing precise RTK positioning, and GUIDAGE, for RTK with automatic guidance equipment in precision farming, civil engineering machine guidance and river dredging. The site also shows a network map, the network status in real time with outage notices (for example an outage and recovery on 4 September 2026), and the state of the ionosphere, which affects measurement quality, with a technical helpdesk and a 7-day on-call line. Access is by request through the site, and the cost and licence terms were not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the site is in French, and service depends on network availability, as the outage notices show. Coverage is Wallonia. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, dependence of surveying and construction guidance on GNSS, and space weather effects through ionospheric conditions; related records are the Netherlands GNSS reference data and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
